relationship_description: Father-son, Eduardo 'Tatang' was Governor (1960-1986, 1988-1990), Tomas III was Governor (1989-1990, 1992-1995, 1998-2007) and Vice Governor
Father-son, Eduardo Nonato 'Edno' was Representative (1988, 2007-2010), Governor (1995-1998), and NFA Administrator
Father-son, Mariano Cristino 'Boyet' is Mayor of Quezon town (the Joson's political stronghold)
Married couple, Araceli is granddaughter of General Mariano Noriel, they had six children
Father-son, Edward Thomas is former Vice Governor who ran for Governor
Brothers who had political rivalry, Edno backs different candidates than Boyet in gubernatorial races
Possible father-son relationship, Rafael is part of the Joson political dynasty of Nueva Ecija
Father-son, Presbitero had three children: Vincent Michael, Lord Allan Jay, and Tricia Nicole
Brothers, sons of SC Justice Presbitero Velasco Jr.
Siblings, children of Presbitero Velasco Jr.
